Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 85: July 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #85 shipped to subscribers in June 2008 (bearing the cover date of July 2008 for Issue 85). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #85 kicked off the summer season with high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media content:

Robert Ludlum's The Bourne Conspiracy (third-person espionage action shooter)
Kung Fu Panda (movie tie-in action-adventure platformer)
Football Manager 2008 (sports management simulation)
Battlezone (Xbox Live Arcade sci-fi tank combat arcade remaster)
Mr. Driller Online (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle-action game)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom downloadable dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes and artwork galleries for titles like Darksiders: Wrath of War, Gears of War 2, Resident Evil 5, and Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts—alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
